research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Zuiyou is researching and developing methods for dynamically updating applets within its platform, as described in the small program dynamic update method, device and medium based on Flutter, which details constructing an applet framework and compiling service code upon receiving requests. This focus is complemented by work on a language code compiling method, device, equipment and medium, aimed at optimizing code compilation processes. These efforts highlight advancements in applet management and code compilation.
